d:
The Celtics defeated the Hornets, 119-80, tonight in Charlotte. Jayson Tatum finished with a team-high 34 points along with 9 assists and 8 rebounds for the Celtics, while Derrick White tallied 18 points, 5 assists, and 4 rebounds in the game. Naz Reid recorded 14 points, 6 rebounds, and 2 assists. The Celtics improve their record to 7-2 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 3-7 for the season.
